canonicalization: finance-request-v1: exactly version, operation_id, method, public path, present typed query, normalized body/null, idempotency_key/null; JCS SHA-256; no secrets/headers/traces/defaults. Validate scale before normalization. Arrays retain order; omission != null; duplicate/unknown keys/query rejected.
money: ARS final strings exactly scale 2, <=38 integer digits, no float/exponent/sign/extra scale or cash rounding; applied=accepted total>0; received>=applied; change=received-applied; ledger +=applied only.
opening: One logical register per canonical POS and one open shift per register. Opening zero emits shift fact only; positive adds exactly one movement. Same operation replay never adds funds. No closure by midnight or implicit shift switch.
payment: Authenticate sales-pos and fresh persisted step decision including exact command/step_id/hash/stock/context/responsible. Validate current open owned shift, not the stale observed cart counter. Serial local effect; no network under lock. Unknown is not rejection. Terminal deterministic rejection closes attempt against late duplicate.
atomicity: One local SQL transaction: payment+movement+expected+semantic identity+result+history+audit+inbox/outbox; failure rolls back all. Rejection retains terminal result without payment or movement. Broker ACK does not prove physical cash or exactly once.
semantic_identity: organization+operation+sale+payment_id+method, and command identity; independently unique sale/payment links prevent another command_id from charging again. Retain identity with fact after 7-day HTTP replay and 35/90 transport cleanup.
history: ADR-063 section 4: retained original UTF-8 JSON and checksum, per-org sequence serialized until commit, sessions <=30min and current human authority/step-up each page. Cursor HMAC exclusive key binds account/tenant/session/filters/limit/H/last/version/disposition generation; 50 default/100 max, page <=1MiB, fact <=128KiB. Changed generation returns 409; gaps mean partial, unknown source 503; reading never republishes or executes.
location: createPosCashRegister Location is the authorized pos-filtered collection (one logical register per POS); openCashShift points to getCashShift; history creation points to session facts. No uncontracted individual GET.
retries: Same immutable command; maximum five logical attempts with exponential backoff 1s+jitter capped 30s, Retry-After, attention after exhausted or 15min. Transport redelivery never resets budget; no auto refund or stock compensation on unknown/success.
compatibility: Only known type/revision=1. Producer strict; consumer permits declared optional payload.extensions.source_note only, no money/authority effect. Unsupported enums/versions quarantine without effects/checkpoint.
obligations_runtime: F1-12: PostgreSQL/RLS, concurrency, terminal uniqueness, rollback, ES256/HMAC/current authority, broker, lost response, retained reconstruction after cleaning outbox. Contracts prove none of these.
